synopsis: Arnoick, the strongest Sword Saint in history, has died. His sword techniques were passed on to his disciples, and it was thought that his story had come to an end— But then…! Arnoick is reincarnated as a breathtakingly beautiful maid named Annette! With her slender arms and frail body, she should have given up the path of the sword and lived a quiet, peaceful life. However, in order to protect Rosalena, the daughter of a fallen noble family, she rises up broom in hand. An ultimate do-over fantasy of the strongest warrior reborn—from old man to beautiful girl! (Comic Gardo Translated)

title: KaguRai: Kagura to Raito
synopsis: Kagura is a samurai girl known as the "Sword Saint" for her mastery of the way of the sword. And Raito is a boy who belongs to a race called "Hito-youkai" that is hated by the people. The two met in their childhood and spent happy times together as best friends. Until the difference in their races separated them. Kagura took up the sword for Raito. To "live together" in order to do so, the bond between the two that transcends years transcends walls, races, and reality!! A one-shot story in the Sunday magazine received such a great response that it has been decided to serialize it! A Japanese-Western mixed fantasy with overwhelming brushwork that will rush out into the world! The start of this story!! (Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

title: Streaming War
titleNative: ストリーミング・ウォー
synopsis: To become a top-notch streamer, a reckless girl named Yoru Kihara, also known as "Angel Hell," earns money through extreme streaming. Thanks to the support of her fans, she managed to save up her target amount to move to the city. However, her abusive parents took everything: her savings and her streaming equipment. In utter despair, Yoru attempts her final act—streaming her own suicide from an abandoned building. But suddenly, she’s attacked by someone wearing a creepy rabbit mask. This marks her fateful encounter with "Streaming War," a grotesque streaming site where underground streamers go to satisfy their insatiable need for recognition!

title: A Man's Man
synopsis: Yuhyeon becomes the youngest CEO of Hansung, a successful electronics company built on toxic work culture, but nobody he cares about is there to celebrate with him. After a night of drinking and wondering if he could change the past, he wakes up the next morning, 20 years younger at the beginning of his career. Armed with the experience and insights that made him CEO, Yuhyeon begins to revisit broken relationships and battle the enablers of Hansung’s cut-throat work environment. But he does not yet know how changing the past will affect his future... (Source: WEBTOON)
